title: Price coupled old and fresh BIT line occupancy changes
body:
Exact pricing covers 35,168 state assignments. Of 16,630 nested assignments, 16,534 have identically zero signed change and 96 lose at both trials.

## Scope and source

Uses 3,394 rational directions pinned by #7910, changes old and fresh occupancy together in two adjacent components, and retains the 411 and main boundary and complete caller. The complete source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The archive identifies additional inputs by exact commit, path and hash. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; P104 toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit-old-fresh-line-exchange/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory. Check its inner checksum manifest. `python3 -B scan_two.py`, `verify_raw.py` and `exchange.py` reproduced both incidence scans and the exact projector control. The archive preserves the verification evidence and controls. This is an offline research archive; hosted package execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Study new timed incidence or broader supports with a checked complete caller and finite supplier.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. Related results: [P104 campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
